# Paurush Rai

> Senior Software Engineer and Frontend-Focused Full-Stack Developer with 5+ years building enterprise SaaS, AI-integrated platforms, and developer tools. Based in India, working with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js.

Personal portfolio and case-study site. Content below is available in 12 languages; URLs shown are the English (default) versions.

- [Blog](https://paurushrai.in/blogs): Writing on software engineering, frontend architecture, developer tooling, and automation.
- [Services](https://paurushrai.in/services): Freelance engineering services and engagement types (full-stack builds, frontend architecture, AI integrations, LMS plugins, retainers).
- [Contact](https://paurushrai.in/contact): How to get in touch about work.
